title: Bank of Baroda Apprentices Admit Card 2026
intro: Short Information : Bank of Baroda (BOB) has released the admit card for the post of Apprentice. This recruitment was released for 5000 posts. Applications for the Bank of Baroda Apprentices Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 19 May 2026, to 15 June 2026. The online examination is going to be conducted on 21 June 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Bank of Baroda Apprentices Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.
importantDates: Last Date For Fee Payment : 15 June 2026
Result Date : Will Be Updated Here Soon
applicationFee: Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
